newsitem.title: USA: Louisville feeder cattle market steady - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Louisville feeder cattle market steady - USDA.

text.p: Feeder steers and heifers were steady, compared to last week's close, USDA said. Quality pens of black/black-whiteface calves not well tested.

Feeder Steers - Medium and Large 1 600- 700 lbs 58.00-64.75; 700-800 lbs Few 56.50-58.50; 800-900 lbs Few 56.50- 58.75. Medium and Large 2 500-600 lbs Few 50.00-52.00; 700-800 lbs 48.50-52.50. Holstein Large 2 12 head 307 lbs 42.50; 21 head 841 lbs 39.00.
Feeder Heifers - Medium and Large 1 500-600 lbs 44.00-52.00; 600-700 lbs 46.00-52.00; Pkg. 737 lbs 51.50. Medium and Large 2 500- 600 lbs 35.50-43.00. Cattle and Calves Receipts - 3,200
